tools.name: check_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Free static structural validation of a sanitized n8n workflow export. Finds missing node references, duplicate IDs, malformed connections and configuration risks. Returns evidence, classifications, repair suggestions and limitations. Does not execute code, test credentials, fetch URLs or prove runti

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_n8n_workflow" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_n8n_workflow · Private data: check_n8n_workflow · Public sink: check_n8n_workflow · Destructive: check_n8n_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_n8n_workflow · Private data: check_n8n_workflow · Public sink: check_n8n_workflow · Destructive: check_n8n_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
